name: Jeremy King
source:
Likes: Sighing, complaining, practical things
Dislikes: Impractical things, the hobby shop, having to exist

Sigh-incarnate Jeremy is mopey, to say the least. There's nothing that he wants to do, though he's such a defeatist that with some pushing you can get him to do almost anything. On rare occasions he can be a bit chipper, but it's only when he's being a little smart-ass.

[From [url=https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/post/160243711416/we-made-some-shiny-new-character-bio-images-for]Tumblr[/url]]
